market.question: Will Brent Hennrich advance to the general election for WA-03?

assessment.reasoning: Hennrich is a long-shot Democratic primary challenger to incumbent Marie Gluesenkamp Perez. Under WA top-two primary, MGP (incumbent Democrat) and a leading Republican (Braun/Walsh) are heavy favorites for top-2. Hennrich would need to out-poll MGP within Democrats AND outpoll the leading Republican overall — very unlikely.
data_sources: chronline.com poll commissioned by MGP challenger
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possible Democratic vote split or unexpected MGP scandal; current data show MGP strong fundraiser and well-positioned.
